contract.animation_pass: AnimationVM_RunActorPass clears the byte before animation dispatch.
contract.movement_pass: MovementVM_TickActors sets the byte to 0xFF before movement dispatch.
contract.shared_handlers: ActorVM_ClearAnimationOrMovementCursor and ActorVM_SetStreamTimerAndLoop use the zero/nonzero domain to select animation or movement actor fields.

conclusion: The byte identifies which actor VM field family shared opcodes must mutate during the current pass.
